reason: We already pay a tutor to get him ready for school, and I'm trying to keep him off the phone, not give him another reason to be on it. I might install the free version to look at it, but I'm not paying for PRO in the first month.
objection: I don't want my child glued to the phone. An app can't replace a real teacher sitting next to him, and I can't tell from this what PRO adds over the free part.
would_change_my_mind: If the tutor or the kindergarten teacher recommended it as 10-15 minutes of homework a day, with a hard daily time limit I control from the parent area.
